item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. If anyone builds superintelligence with anything like current techniques, everyone on Earth will die. We refuse to accept that future. We demand a legally binding prohibition on its development.

2. We cannot survive superintelligence built with anything like current techniques. It will kill everyone on Earth. Our demand is simple: prohibit its development by law. No company has the right to gamble with humanity’s existence.

3. If anyone builds superintelligence with anything like current techniques, everyone on Earth will die. We are organising to stop that from happening. Humanity’s survival must come before the race to build it.

### (b) Newsletter opening

If anyone builds superintelligence with anything like current techniques, everyone on Earth will die. We will not soften that warning, and we will not accept that outcome. No one knows how to build these systems safely. Yet companies are racing towards capabilities that would put humanity’s future beyond our control. We are working for a legally binding prohibition on developing superintelligence because our survival cannot depend on promises from the people building it. We need enforceable law, not voluntary restraint. Together, we can demand that governments stop this race before it reaches its destination. We have a future worth protecting, and we intend to protect it.
